items.claim: Leica holds a massive weight advantage of nearly 50 pounds over Poppik.
items.quote: Poppik weighed in at 215, whereas Lea weighed in at like 260, 2 and a half. I mean, that's almost a 50 lb weight difference.

items.quote: Poppik's a guy that's fought at middleweight, you know, before.

items.claim: Poppik is taking the fight on short notice in the wrong weight class.
items.quote: he's coming in on short notice at the wrong weight class.

items.claim: Haley Cowan has four losses inside the distance, including three by submission and one by knockout.
items.quote: Haley Cowan has four losses inside the distance. Three by sub, one by knockout.

items.claim: Haley Cowan lacks notable skills outside of having a size advantage.
items.quote: Haley Cowan. Just not sure what she's good at outside of being big.
